messages:
rachel: deploy-bot is flagging a cross-region p95 regression after the 2.10.0 rollout. eu-west and us-west show tail increases but eu-west is worse.
deploy-bot: deploybot:signal: p95 > threshold for 4m in eu-west and 3m in us-west. recommendation: STAGED_UNWIND per-region (eu-west first). auto_revert: OFF. suggested slices: 5% -> 20% -> 100%. reason: new kernel affinity + kv-cache TTL tweak.
ops-oncall: agree with per-region unwind. we'll avoid global auto-revert to prevent churn. plan: eu-west 5% now, soak 5m, run smoke eval "crossreg_tail_v1". if stable, move to 20% -> 100%. us-west will follow after eu-west.
nines: can we disable burst autoscale in eu-west during the soak to reduce noise?
ops-oncall: yes: `autoscalectl set-burst --region eu-west --enabled false`
product: prepping a short status blurb and customer watchlist alert. no external posting until 20% confirmed.
ml-oncall: note: new kernel affinity improves throughput but amplifies kv-cache cold-starts on some routes; likely cause. standing by for quick patch if unwind doesn't help.
ops-oncall: executing eu-west 5% unwind: `infractl pin --region eu-west --route /generate --version 2.9.9 --slice 5 --reason "p95 tail eu-west"`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1812347890-1
rachel: posting internal-only: "Investigating p95 tail in eu-west after 2.10.0. Performing staged unwind of kernel affinity. Will update after 20%."
ops-oncall: 5m soak complete, p95 improved ~48% in eu-west, errors unchanged. running smoke eval now.
deploy-bot: eval: crossreg_tail_v1 -> latency_ok=true quality_ok=true
product: ready to move to 20% and publish the public blurb after confirmation.
ops-oncall: moving to 20%: `infractl pin --region eu-west --route /generate --version 2.9.9 --slice 20`
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1812347890-2
ops-oncall: 20% stable after 4m. p95 near baseline. proceeding to 100% and then will replicate in us-west.
deploy-bot: deploybot:action: pin_job started id=pin-1812347890-3
support: publishing to customer watchlist and #incidents: "Staged rollback completed in eu-west to mitigate tail latency after 2.10.0. us-west is being evaluated and will follow if needed."
ops-oncall: now starting us-west 5% unwind. will follow same steps.
ml-oncall: if us-west doesn't stabilize, propose a quick kernel backport patch to handle kv-cache TTL behavior.
ops-oncall: us-west 5% applied. monitoring.
ops-oncall: us-west 5% stable after 6m, p95 improved ~35%. ramping to 20% then 100% per plan.
product: creating INF ticket INF-2026-520 for postmortem, release-note amendment, and onboarding test updates.
rachel: follow-ups: add kv-cache TTL regression to preflight, note kernel-affinity in rollout docs, and keep auto-revert off for similar kernels until we have a preflight test. closing thread when INF ticket shows up.
deploy-bot: deploybot:signal: pin_job completed id=pin-1812347890-3 status=success
